title: Cap’s ex came back with a speech.
caption: Capricorn's ex sprinted back with a bouquet and a rehearsed speech. Words are a start, but change you can trust shows up in actions, over time. You're allowed to wait and see. Send this to the friend whose ex just said "I've changed."
